messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary cohort "alpha-3" error-rate +2.8% and p95 +42% on /v1/complete (us-west-1). Auto-rollback criteria met. Recommend auto-revert to v4.2.0. https://telemetry.redwood/alpha-3 :rotating_light:

riley: noticed. looks like the new kv-cache change is correlated. Does anyone have pinned dedicated pools in us-west-1?

jamal: checking pins — one customer has a soft pin for scheduled migration (not locked), not a commit. hosted only otherwise.

product: product asks to avoid auto-rollback if we can limit blast radius; they'd like a quick review so release notes are consistent.

sre-oncall: metric is sustained. if we delay auto-rollback >5m and it worsens i'll escalate. current p95 is still rising.

riley: proposal: 1) lock auto-rollback for 10m, 2) pin region to previous version to stop rollout, 3) targeted revert of alpha-3, 4) hold change window 1h. That keeps the rollback manual and gives comms time.

kate: i'll prep a short public blurb and a one-off customer note. CS: ready to send if jamal confirms any customer impact.

cs-lead: the soft-pinned customer is on a migration path but not affected today. i'll standby with an individualized note in case they report issues.

jamal: executing lock: 
```
deployctl lock --actor jamal --reason "manual-review-alpha-3"
```

jamal: pinning hosted region: 
```
releasectl pin --svc hosted --region us-west-1 --version v4.2.0 --by jamal
```

jamal: running targeted revert: 
```
rolloutctl revert --group alpha-3 --to v4.2.0 --reason "p95+error regression"
```

sre-oncall: seeing p95 drop now. error-rate falling. monitor 30m then release lock.

kate: pub blurb draft: "We reverted a canary cohort in us-west-1 for /v1/complete due to increased latency and errors after a KV-cache optimization. We restored the cohort to v4.2.0. Impact: brief elevated latency for a small subset of hosted traffic. No dedicated customers were impacted. No action required. A postmortem will follow."

product: fine. include note to look at kv-cache heuristics before next rollout.

jamal: revert complete; cohort alpha-3 stable on v4.2.0. link: https://telemetry.redwood/alpha-3?view=post-revert

sre-oncall: holding monitoring window. if stable in 30m we unlock and close. :white_check_mark:

riley: thanks team — we'll run a brief retro and add stricter gate for kv-cache flags. closing thread after monitoring.
